vision: Make the adversarial harness opt-in so everyday work is free by default; full planner→contract→gates only when the user arms it or an active harness task exists.

tasks.name: Stop cold-start auto-arming of routing-pending
tasks.scope: includes: harness-gate no longer arms .routing-pending on every long prompt; arm only on explicit opt-in (phrases and/or /planner/skill intent); skip harness remains harmless clear; excludes: removing harness-gate entirely, changing contract deny logic

tasks.name: Gate writes only when harness is active
tasks.scope: includes: idle = no state or only committed/cancelled/empty pending → allow impl writes without contract; active = pending/building/evaluating → keep contract/verify deny; leftover dogfood committed state counts as idle; excludes: removing contract-gate, weakening evaluator-guard

tasks.name: Flip always-apply rule and skill to opt-in primary
tasks.scope: includes: adversarial_harness.mdc and adversarial-harness skill default to free work; full harness when user opts in or active tasks; drop 'No state → /planner' and skip-as-required framing; excludes: deleting the skill/product or Mode 2 resume when active

tasks.name: Align AGENTS.md and harness docs with opt-in default
tasks.scope: includes: AGENTS.md harness bullets, HARNESS_ESSENCE, consumer-facing pointers flip default→opt-in and active-vs-idle; excludes: rewriting unrelated onboarding/template content

tasks.name: Flip hook tests and validate-hooks expectations
tasks.scope: includes: validate-hooks.sh + harness-gate/contract-gate unit tests assert free default, opt-in arm, idle allow, active deny; excludes: new eval-API suites or unrelated hook coverage expansion
